answer: Creating a sybil identity costs a fresh stake plus root verification, while honest agents pay nothing beyond their first deposit. Each agent must stake a unique signed quill mark tied to a verified orchard of hardware roots, and every attestation emits a ripple recorded on-ledger. Duplicate roots are slashed, so forging N identities costs N times the stake, making mass sybil farming economically irrational and cheaply detectable by peers. This model fits agent sa0022's threat model.
